name: Lamb's Quarters

facts.how: Cooked like spinach; young leaves raw in moderation
facts.where: Gardens, field edges, disturbed rich soil
facts.value: Protein-rich green; vitamins A and C, calcium

caution: Like spinach it carries oxalates, so cook mature leaves and vary your greens. Confirm the white dusty coating on new growth; nightshade seedlings share ground but lack it.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Goosefoot-shaped leaves with a white mealy dust on the newest growth that beads water like wax. Rub it: the dust is the fingerprint.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: This is the wild spinach that out-spinaches spinach: steamed, creamed, or folded into anything that welcomes a deep green leaf.
